title: Pineapple: modeled ₹815/qtl left, Perumbavoor → Kottayam
summary: January 2024: reported pineapple prices at Perumbavoor and Kottayam imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 92% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹815 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 98 same-variety market pairs screened for pineapple in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (Pine Apple, Medium) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kottayam report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor (Kerala) and Kottayam (Kerala) both reported pineapple prices for the same variety and grade (Pine Apple, Medium) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Perumbavoor reported a median ₹3,250 per quintal. Kottayam reported a median ₹4,900 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,000/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,000 per quintal, and Kottayam was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 73 km by road
scenes.caption: 73 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹16/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹617 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹412 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kottayam report, the rule selects 18 of 24 modeled shipping days. 18 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹815 per quintal (₹564 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pineapple route from Perumbavoor to Kottayam was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹81,500, or ₹56,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pineapple
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹16/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pineapple route from Perumbavoor to Kottayam was positive on 92% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹81,500, or ₹56,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
